types.name: google.protobuf.FeatureSetDefaults.FeatureSetEditionDefault
types.doc:
A map from every known edition with a unique set of defaults to its
 defaults. Not all editions may be contained here.  For a given edition,
 the defaults at the closest matching edition ordered at or before it should
 be used.  This field must be in strict ascending order by edition.

fields.name: overridable_features
fields.doc: Defaults of features that can be overridden in this edition.

fields.name: fixed_features
fields.doc: Defaults of features that can't be overridden in this edition.
